headline_findings: [MOCK] Starbucks rewrote its Risk Factors more than any other company in the sample.
[MOCK] Union Pacific added a block of new risks tied to its proposed merger with Norfolk Southern.
[MOCK] Tariff risk was the most common genuinely new category across restaurants and apparel.
[MOCK] Most changes elsewhere were rewording rather than new risks.

spotlight.name: Union Pacific Corporation
spotlight.summary: [MOCK] Union Pacific added 21 new risk units, almost all about the proposed merger. Its prior-year risks were carried over unchanged.
